CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid templates by Ferdinand99 — self-hosted apps with a web UI, each one in one container.
**Sylo** — a multi-function Discord bot: moderation with a numbered case log, logging, tickets / modmail answered from the dashboard, reaction roles, verification, welcome messages, auto-moderation, leveling, temporary voice channels, giveaways, polls, Twitch / YouTube / Kick / RSS alerts and much more, with optional "Log in with Discord". Also available as a hosted bot at https://sylobot.com.
**Sylo-Fluxer** (beta) — Sylo ported to Fluxer (https://fluxer.app): the same modules and dashboard, prefix commands (! by default) and "Log in with Fluxer". Some features don't work as expected yet — see its README.
**Tofarr** — an unofficial companion for the Tofa media server: build Tofa collections from TMDB, Trakt and IMDb lists, keep them in order and up to date on a schedule, browse a Discover page with posters, and request missing titles through Seerr. Protected by a login you create on first start.
State lives in a single SQLite file on a mounted volume.
**Support:** open an issue on the app's repository — https://github.com/Ferdinand99/Sylo/issues or https://github.com/Ferdinand99/Sylo-Fluxer/issues or https://github.com/Ferdinand99/Tofarr/issues
